id: title:Gilbert09:add aws macie resource profile and usage tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds AWS Macie V2 ingestion support, including usage statistics, bucket sensitivity profiles, and IAM permissions, alongside comprehensive tests for pagination, resource profile detection, and state recovery.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F5.H1 adds documentation and IAM permission requirements for AWS Macie V2 ingestion, while P1.F6.H1 and P1.F6.H2 introduce executable implementation and comprehensive tests for usage statistics, bucket fan-out, and resource profile detection. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion and connector reliability.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and tests, but the actual runtime benefit and production adoption are not independently verified; the score does not account for unverified outcomes or actual user benefit.
